import json, glob
res={}
cands = sorted(glob.glob('inputs/*')) + sorted(glob.glob('/inputs/*')) + sorted(glob.glob('*'))
res['cands']=cands[:40]
xlsx=[c for c in cands if c.lower().endswith(('.xlsx','.xlsm'))]
res['xlsx']=xlsx
try:
    man=[c for c in cands if c.endswith('manifest.json')]
    if man:
        res['manifest']=json.load(open(man[0]))
except Exception as e:
    res['man_err']=repr(e)
try:
    import openpyxl
    p=xlsx[0]
    wf=openpyxl.load_workbook(p, data_only=False)
    wv=openpyxl.load_workbook(p, data_only=True)
    sheets={}
    for nm in wf.sheetnames:
        sf=wf[nm]; sv=wv[nm]
        sample=[]
        for r in range(1, min(sf.max_row,3)+1):
            for c in range(1, sf.max_column+1):
                cf=sf.cell(r,c); cv=sv.cell(r,c)
                sample.append([cf.coordinate, repr(cf.value)[:90], cf.data_type, cf.number_format, repr(cv.value)[:60]])
        sheets[nm]=sample
    res['sheets']=sheets
    sv=wv['Export']; sf=wf['Export']
    res['export_C']=[[sv.cell(r,3).coordinate, repr(sv.cell(r,3).value)] for r in range(1, sv.max_row+1)]
    res['export_A']=[[sf.cell(r,1).coordinate, repr(sf.cell(r,1).value), sf.cell(r,1).data_type, sf.cell(r,1).number_format] for r in range(1, min(sf.max_row,13)+1)]
    sv1=wv['Counts']; sv2=wv['Pack factors']
    res['counts']=[[repr(sv1.cell(r,1).value), repr(sv1.cell(r,2).value)] for r in range(2, sv1.max_row+1)]
    res['pack']=[[repr(sv2.cell(r,1).value), repr(sv2.cell(r,2).value)] for r in range(2, sv2.max_row+1)]
except Exception as e:
    res['xl_err']=repr(e)
print(json.dumps(res, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)[:9000])
